terra.problem: Titus working alongside Paul is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage mentions the Corinthians' longing but does not say they wanted Paul physically close.
A refilled cookie jar suggests it had been depleted, while Paul's joy increased. The comparison does not match the action.
The passage says Paul rejoiced all the more, but does not say the report lifted his worry.
Paul says he does not rejoice because the Corinthians were made sorrowful. Saying he does not enjoy anyone's tears makes a broader claim the text does not give.
Salvation without regret does not establish that there is no leftover shame to carry.
Saying Paul meant the line to be heavy assigns him an intention the text does not state.
Paul says he did not write on account of the person who did wrong or the person harmed. The text does not say he was not writing to point fingers at them.
Paul says his boasting to Titus about the Corinthians proved true, not that everything he said to Titus held up.
The text describes obedience and a welcome with fear and trembling. It does not say nobody hesitated or dragged their feet.
The passage does not describe the welcome as humble. Fear and trembling do not necessarily establish humility.
